title: Standard enthalpy of formation, Gibbs energy of formation, entropy and molar heat capacity of organic substances
description: Comprehensive data table for thermodynamic properties of organic substances at 25°C (298.15 K), including standard enthalpy of formation (ΔH°f), Gibbs free energy of formation (ΔG°f), standard entropy (S°), and molar heat capacity (Cp) in their standard states (gas or liquid).
